scope: France-departure (origin-side) requirement facts for a departing French tax resident on the FR->SG corridor (Paris->Singapore), French national. Net-new origin-side facts for this corridor. Covers: transfer of tax residence / change-of-address declaration and SIP-NR handover; departure-year 2042-NR split filing; loss of attachment to the French social security regime on taking expatriate status; optional CFE health cover; A1/detachement certificate scope (EU/EEA/CH only) with an explicit needs_lawyer_review flag on the FR-SG totalization position (no bilateral social security convention); expatriate unemployment-scheme 8-day affiliation deadline; CAF family-benefit cessation when the family accompanies the mover.
sources_used: impots.gouv.fr (Je pars vivre a l'etranger, quelles demarches)
source_access_notes: ameli.fr returned no scrapable text (HTTP 403 / empty body) from this egress; the health-cessation fact was therefore sourced from the whitelisted service-public.gouv.fr F55 page instead. The FR-SG no-convention position is corroborated by French Senate written question n.00126 (2022) but the fact source_url is kept to the whitelisted service-public.gouv.fr F3155 page and the item is flagged needs_lawyer_review.
